state.title: State (2-letter)
state.description: Which state's water systems to read, e.g. AZ.

county.title: County
county.description: Keep only systems whose county or town matches this. Blank means the whole state.

systemType.title: System type
systemType.description: CWS = community, TNCWS = transient non-community, NTNCWS = non-transient non-community.

populationMin.title: Minimum people served
populationMin.description: Keep only systems serving at least this many people. 0 means all.

maxItems.title: Max water systems
maxItems.description: Stop after this many systems. Hard ceiling is 1000, so a run cannot run away.

timeoutSeconds.title: Run timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Stop collecting after this many seconds so a run cannot hang.
